english.title: Cultivate cannabis plant - class C - but see the note below before using this wording
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) cultivated

(A)_[a plant]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..) plants]_

of the genus cannabis, a controlled drug of class C, in contravention of section 6(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(2) of and Schedule 4 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cultivation of cannabis plant(s)

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Offence Wording is NOW OBSOLETE. Offence reclassified to Class B as from 26/01/09. See CJS Code MD71440 Standard Offence Wording H9377..

(i) **IMPORTANT** H.O.C. 82/1980 recommends that the cultivation of cannabis be charged under 'producing cannabis' or being 'concerned in the production of cannabis' (see H6149 and H6148 respectively) in view of the definition of 'produce' in section 37(1) of the Act.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding he statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
